rubric.availability_conditioned: Secondary only: count and denominator of fully available questions for each condition; do not remove unavailable questions from primary metrics.

budget_matched_diagnostic.selection: Existing primary evidence order; keep only complete original physical lines entirely inside actual returned spans. Do not add indentation/newlines or reorder evidence. Stop if a remaining line exceeds available budget. This extra diagnostic may omit partial boundary lines and does not modify standard results.

rubric.citations: Original byte ranges for BM25; exact original physical lines for Skill; validation never normalizes source. Invalid evidence cannot satisfy source anchors.
rubric.complete: ALL_OF components; ANY_OF explicit source alternatives per component; ALL_OF non-whitespace original line-content anchors per alternative. Multiple returned fragments may jointly cover an anchor. No credit from metadata-only path/symbol/range overlap.
rubric.completeness_dedup: Union valid actual byte intervals by repository/path; repeating text cannot increase source coverage.
rubric.empty_evidence: Completeness false; component coverage 0; precision and citation accuracy null (undefined), never perfect.
rubric.estimated_tokens: Byte length / 4, labeled heuristic only; no tokenizer/provider usage measured.
rubric.partial: Fraction of complete components; best per-component anchor fraction additionally reported. Partial evidence means some frozen anchor is returned but not every component is complete.
rubric.precision: Positive annotations are the exact union of frozen source anchors across alternatives. Unit relevant iff it contains at least one complete positive anchor. Character numerator counts Unicode characters in intersection of the actual returned byte span and positive annotation union. Denominator counts all actual evidence text characters, including repeated spans in the returned stream; overlaps within one unit count once. This is annotation-based specificity, not exhaustive semantic relevance.
rubric.precision_unannotated: Unannotated alternative evidence may still be useful. Report this limitation explicitly; do not label all unannotated content semantically irrelevant.
rubric.submitted_skill_evidence: Deduplicate actual returned evidence records and exact source snippets in returned reference lists. Reference path/name metadata without returned source text cannot satisfy requirements. Character precision uses the full returned source stream, preserving repeats; reference JSON metadata is separately charged by V1 and not counted as source text.
